'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Mike Gemme DS My Lord, Is That Legal?''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike Gemme]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|My Lord, Is That Legal? / I Will Make It Legal|Cor-D-mylordisthatlegal.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' eating ONES???!
* '''Username:''' DECK
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
